fields.tooltip: Fill every file's title + description from EntityFilesLocalization, picking the language from the player's OS (fallback English). Icons/unlock untouched.

fields.tooltip: If Entries is empty, FileEntry children of this root are collected instead.

fields.name: canvasGroup
fields.tooltip: The panel is shown/hidden through this CanvasGroup so the controller stays active (and keeps listening for the open key) while the panel is hidden. Auto-added from this object if left empty.

fields.name: openButton
fields.tooltip: The 'Files' battery button. Tapping it toggles the panel (mainly for mobile, where the cursor is free and there is no keyboard).

fields.name: openKey
fields.tooltip: Desktop key that toggles the panel. The battery button shows this letter.

fields.name: desktopKeyHint
fields.tooltip: The key-hint label on the battery button (the 'F'). Hidden on mobile.

fields.name: clueManager
fields.tooltip: The panel refuses to open while any of these full-screen screens is up, so two paused views never stack on top of each other.

fields.name: uiAudioSource
fields.tooltip: Auto-added (2D) if empty. Plays clickSound on each panel/detail action.

fields.name: unlockNotification
fields.tooltip: Toast shown when a file unlocks. Auto-found if empty.

fields.name: speed
fields.tooltip: Path speed, radians/second.

fields.name: mover

fields.name: cameraTransform
fields.tooltip: Camera to watch. Auto-found (FPS controller camera / Camera.main).

fields.name: dismissAngle

fields.name: mapPanel
fields.tooltip: Used so the marker only recomputes while the map is open. Auto-found.

fields.name: worldRefA
fields.tooltip: Point A — world position. X = world X, Y = world Z of a known spot.

fields.name: mapRefA
fields.tooltip: Point A — the marker's anchoredPosition on the map for that same spot.

fields.name: worldRefB
fields.tooltip: Point B — a DIFFERENT world position (X = world X, Y = world Z).

fields.name: mapRefB
fields.tooltip: Point B — the marker's anchoredPosition on the map for that spot.

fields.name: headingOffset
fields.tooltip: Extra spin (degrees) so an arrow marker points the right way for your texture.

fields.name: clampInsideMap
fields.tooltip: Keep the marker from leaving the map image bounds.

fields.name: startValue
